scope: Fixes from the Claude live test; no release publication or modification of the user's main Minecraft instance.
fixes: Keep spelled-out duration units and percent signs visible to translation; mask changing numbers and preserve compact countdown caching.
Read Claude thinking_tokens as a subtotal of output tokens without adding it to the total twice.
Skip the exact three-ball loading animation, including styled variants, without excluding surrounding prose.
Record connection-test errors through the existing debug log.
Display API connection-test results in the existing scrollable dialog on modern clients.

live.timingNote: End-to-end time includes the configured chat batch delay; measured from the recorded submit action to the session usage update, not the exact render frame.
observed: No translation requests or tokens during world loading before the test text.
Three test paragraphs retained their color and displayed the translated seconds and percentage damage correctly.
Changing only quantities and color reused the cached translation with current values and no additional request.
One deliberate nonexistent-model test returned HTTP 404 in a readable dialog and an http_error debug entry with operation=test_api.
live.finalState: Claude model restored; online translation disabled in the isolated test instance.

limitations: Only Fabric 26.1.2 was launched for live verification of these fixes; no additional live tests of other providers were performed.
The other modern source trees were compiled; a complete release matrix was not packaged.
Legacy core changes were synchronized and simulated; legacy game UIs were not modernized or launched.
Existing cache entries for percentages and spelled-out durations may require one fresh translation because their semantic keys have changed.
